# `record` for [filters](/commands/categories/filters.md)

<div class='command-title'>Various commands for working with records.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> record {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input   | output |
| ------- | ------ |
| nothing | string |
## Notes
You must use one of the following subcommands. Using this command as-is will only produce this help message.

## Subcommands:

| name                                             | description                                                                                  | type     |
| ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| [`record apply`](/commands/docs/record_apply.md) | Run a record of closures on the matching fields of a record.                                 | built-in |
| [`record each`](/commands/docs/record_each.md)   | Build a new record from the entries a closure returns for each field of a record.            | built-in |
| [`record walk`](/commands/docs/record_walk.md)   | Run a closure on every value nested inside a record, rebuilding the record from the results. | built-in |
| [`record where`](/commands/docs/record_where.md) | Keep the fields of a record for which a row condition or closure is true.                    | built-in |
